title: Tool Result (v1)
description: Structured response envelope returned by tool invocation. Contains the tool-specific data payload, execution evidence for audit and provenance, and an optional error object.

status.description: Outcome: success (data populated), error (error populated), denied (policy rejection).

data.description: Tool-specific result payload. Present when status is success.

evidence.description: Execution provenance metadata for audit and UI rendering.

risk_level.description: Risk classification of the invoked tool.

source_system.description: Identifier of the external system that provided the data, e.g. kubernetes.

error.description: Error details. Present when status is error or denied.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, e.g. K8S_NOT_CONFIGURED, TOOL_NOT_FOUND.
